items.content_html: MindFlash is a minimalist flashcards web app that runs entirely in your browser. Create decks, study with a spaced-repetition system (Leitner with ease tweaks), and view lightweight analytics — no frameworks, no libraries, no backend required. Data is stored safely in your browser via localStorage. You can also export/import your data as JSON.
